Phase-1 foundation training improves offline MRR by **roughly 10–20%** compared with using an off-the-shelf open-source LLM as the backbone (page 7).

- **Section 5.3 text:** Using the Phase-1 foundational LLM as the base model "improves offline ranking metrics by the order of 10-20% compared with using an off-the-shelf LLM as the backbone." The authors credit this to the personalization and content-understanding abilities inherited from the Phase-1 model (page 7).
- **Table 1:** It lists the Phase-1 impact on offline MRR as "+10-20% compared to using an OSS model as base" (page 7).

The paper gives only this range, not a single exact figure. For comparison, Phase-2 post-training adds a further 35–50% gain over a freshly trained Phase-1 model, and that gain grows over time (page 7).

The document has no printed page numbers, so I counted pages from the page breaks in the text.
